length.

Linear elastic 2D model: continuous chords with axial and bending stiffness; pinned axial webs. Deflection includes
web deformation. Steel utilisation uses gross yield and Euler screening; timber uses separately entered design
stresses when supplied. Screens exclude local/distortional/torsional buckling, connection slip, eccentricity,
joint/fastener capacity and second-order effects. It is preliminary, not a construction design or AS 4100 / AS/NZS
4600 / AS 1720.1 approval. Web braces reduce weak-axis restraint length only when confirmed effective; they do
not increase in-plane stiffness. Load factors are user assumptions, not a complete wind/code combination set.
Joint register lists concurrent local member-end N/V/M and bearing reactions for every case. Bolt/weld/bracket
specifications are proposals, NOT VERIFIED capacities. Rigid chord continuity and pinned webs must be justified
by the actual joint detail.
